About.label: WHO I AM
About.alt: Victor M. Santos — Software Engineer & Product Designer
About.subtitle: Software Engineer & Product Designer
About.bio1: My first contact with code was at age 7, setting up Minecraft servers with a friend. Then came Lua for Roblox servers, Python for Discord bots, and what started as a kid's curiosity became something I simply couldn't let go of.
About.bio2: Today I spend most of my time studying, building and breaking things until I understand how they work from the inside out. I like sharing what I learn, I believe teaching is the best way to truly understand something. My goal is to go as far as possible in software engineering and, along the way, build things that make a real difference in people's lives.

TechStack.label: STACK
TechStack.title: What I
TechStack.description: The tools I reach for when crafting digital products: from interface to infrastructure.
TechStack.frontendDesc: Building interfaces from design system to rendered screen. React, Next.js, and TypeScript are my daily tools, with a focus on performance and accessibility.
TechStack.backendDesc: Designing APIs and data layers that hold up under real load. Node.js, Go, and PostgreSQL. I care about correctness over cleverness.
TechStack.toolsDesc: The infrastructure layer: from content modeling in Sanity to container orchestration and CI/CD. What ships is what matters.
